name: v4.0.540
body:
## What's Changed

- `remotion`: [Every effect now has a WebGPU version](https://www.remotion.dev/docs/options/preferred-effect-backend) by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12700
- `@remotion/renderer`: Upgrade Chrome to 158.0.8127.2 and publish build scripts by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12814
- `@remotion/bundler`: Upgrade to Rspack 2.3 by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12146
- `@remotion/media`: Upgrade Mediabunny to 1.64.0 by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12830
- `@remotion/studio`: Show timeline preview images for `<AnimatedImage>` and `<Gif>` by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12807
- `remotion`: Fix long `<OffthreadVideo>` renders on Chrome 158 by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12834
- `remotion`: Skip rerunning effects on an unchanged AnimatedImage frame by @andriidrok1 in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12811
- `remotion`: Avoid Chromium crashes during WebGL effect cleanup by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12710
- `remotion`: Recover canvas effects after WebGL context loss by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12708
- `remotion`: Fix WebGL state leaking between canvas effects by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12694
- `remotion`: Reduce per-frame overhead of `<Sequence>` by @alec-watts in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12688
- `@remotion/effects`: [Add weather, burn, and wipe effects](https://www.remotion.dev/docs/effects/film-burn) by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12598
- `@remotion/effects`: Add WebGL2 and WebGPU backends to 38 effects by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12805
- `@remotion/effects`: Add WebGPU backends to the remaining 49 effects by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12809
- `@remotion/web-renderer`: [Add `renderFramesOnWeb()` for rendering multiple still frames](https://www.remotion.dev/docs/web-renderer/render-frames-on-web) by @alec-watts in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12326
- `@remotion/transitions`: Make `cube()` presentation free by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12657
- `@remotion/studio`: Add a custom playback rate control to the preview toolbar by @Tatsuya0330 in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12601
- `@remotion/animation-utils`: Fix `skew()` with per-axis units and validate `scale()` y by @kjgggggg in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12664
- `@remotion/canvas-capture-extension`: Open Browser Studio recordings on remotion.new by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12659
- `@remotion/captions`: Strip tags and decode character references in `parseVtt()` cue text by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12636
- `@remotion/captions`: Fix `parseVtt()` dropping text of YouTube auto-generated captions by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12623
- `@remotion/cli`: Add missing boolean flags to `CommandLineOptions` by @DeryFerd in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12819
- `@remotion/cli`: Accept `--props` files saved with a UTF-8 BOM by @b84330808 in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12645
- `@remotion/cli`: Respect `--flag false` for 7 boolean options by @DeryFerd in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12629
- `@remotion/cli`: Ignore config file CRF for codecs without CRF support by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12621
- `@remotion/cli`: Report usage for image sequence renders by @costajohnt in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12607
- `@remotion/effects`: Reuse WebGPU pipelines and samplers by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12713
- `@remotion/lambda-go`: Add `GetCompositionsOnLambda()` by @DeryFerd in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12835
- `@remotion/lambda-php`: Add `getCompositionsOnLambda()` by @DeryFerd in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12837
- `@remotion/lambda-python`: Add `get_compositions_on_lambda()` by @DeryFerd in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12836
- `@remotion/lambda-ruby`: Add `get_compositions_on_lambda()` by @DeryFerd in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12838
- `@remotion/media`: Reuse prepared audio when the playback clock changes by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12706
- `@remotion/media`: Bound unshifted audio decoding to the sequence end by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12695
- `@remotion/media`: Remove redundant canvas copies from video previews by @alec-watts in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12684
- `@remotion/media`: Recover when Chrome reclaims idle decoders by @dg314 in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12679
- `@remotion/media`: Fix `<Video>` preview lagging one frame behind render for 29.97fps WebM by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12671
- `@remotion/media`: Bound paused audio decoding with a keep-alive context by @alec-watts in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12609
- `@remotion/media-utils`: Fix `getAudioData()` caching across sample rates by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12556
- `@remotion/motion-blur`: Fix `HtmlInCanvasMotionBlur` render failure by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12690
- `@remotion/paths`: Treat arcs with a zero radius as straight lines by @b84330808 in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12859
- `@remotion/paths`: Fix geometry of chained `T` commands after a non-quadratic command by @b84330808 in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12821
- `@remotion/paths`: Fix `getBoundingBox()` for curves starting with a flat tangent by @b84330808 in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12687
- `@remotion/player`: Fix audio context leak when `<Player>` unmounts by @alec-watts in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12634
- `@remotion/player`: Fix audio interruptions during muted playback by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12606
- `@remotion/renderer`: Forward uncaught exceptions to `onBrowserLog` by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12831
- `@remotion/renderer`: Fix render hanging when a media download fails after frames are rendered by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12829
- `@remotion/renderer`: Report page crashes in still renders instead of timing out by @yongjip in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12682
- `@remotion/renderer`: Fix audio dropouts in distributed AAC renders by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12673
- `@remotion/studio`: Improve render cancellation, output previews, timeline editing, and keyboard controls by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12873
- `@remotion/studio`: Fix stale previews and effect deletion by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12862
- `@remotion/studio`: Preserve pending edits during source updates by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12860
- `@remotion/studio`: Agent-assisted quality improvements by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12857
- `@remotion/studio`: Ask for a composition ID when pre-composing by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12813
- `@remotion/studio`: Open video and audio sources from the Inspector by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12812
- `@remotion/studio`: Use remotion.new in Browser Studio links and copy by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12658
- `@remotion/studio`: Prevent accidental swipe navigation in Safari by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12655
- `@remotion/studio`: Download render output when "Open in Folder" fails by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12649
- `@remotion/studio`: Fix timeline seeking when interactivity is disabled by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12641
- `@remotion/studio`: Delete the adjacent transition or overlay together with a TransitionSeries sequence by @andriidrok1 in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12431
- `@remotion/transitions`: Hold rendering until HTML-in-canvas transitions paint by @BeyondITL-Mossaddique in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12845
- `@remotion/transitions`: Fix OffscreenCanvas errors when reactivating transitions by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12672
- `@remotion/web-renderer`: Fix browser rendering in Safari by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12699
- `@remotion/web-renderer`: Rasterize precomposited layers at the ancestor scale by @BeyondITL-Mossaddique in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12650
- `@remotion/web-renderer`: Fix `mix-blend-mode` being ignored by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12647
- `@remotion/web-renderer`: Release completed render results from queues by @alec-watts in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12631
- Standardize `licenseKey` and `isProduction` across rendering APIs by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12654
- `@remotion/whisper-web`: Deprecate package - use `@remotion/whisper-webgpu` instead by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12828

## Elements

- Hide "Try in remotion.new" button when inside Studio by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12696
- `docs`: Point Element install fallback hint to the drag handle by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12620
- Add OG image for Elements homepage by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12617

## Templates

- Electron template: Upgrade Vite to 6.4.5 by @app/dependabot in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12826
- Vibe Code template: Upgrade Next.js to 16.4.1 by @app/dependabot in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12583
- Electron template: Upgrade Electron to 42.11.16 by @app/dependabot in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12616

## Docs

- [New homepage!](https://remotion.dev) by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/commit/9747b7feba394fcc5c2db6d38b590c4b8b94b3c8
- [Reorganize media guides and sidebar](https://www.remotion.dev/docs/videos/size-and-position) by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12852
- Add runnable product-ad integration example by @dg314 in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12816
- Add Faceless Video Engine to resources page by @igorvieira in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12843
- Check GitHub source links in CI by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12823
- Fix broken pinned-SHA link in video-manipulation page by @DeryFerd in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12820
- Fix broken source links in the AI and media-parser docs by @DeryFerd in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12806
- Fix broken source code links in the Lambda docs by @DeryFerd in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12630
- Speed up snippet checking with TypeScript 7.1 by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12674
- Follow the account mirror preview branch by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12670
- Keep store and purchase links on Remotion Pro by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12669
- Add animated homepage hero to README by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12667
- Mirror account pages on remotion.dev by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12668
- Point SDK demo links to sdk-demo.remotion.dev by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12663
- Add VideoGen to ecosystem products by @dg314 in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12651
- Deprecate `@remotion/enable-scss` by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12646
- Clarify contribution expectations in contributing guide by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12639
- Explain how to set a license key in the Studio and CLI by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12626
- Add instructions for starting Studio with an AI agent by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12619
- New homepage hero section by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12613
- [Expand Canvas Capture installation and recording guides](https://www.remotion.dev/docs/canvas-capture/how-to-use) by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/commit/5695921145a4c2b69a088de2359f8bb19f0a2a3d

## Internal and Experimental

- Import Lambda binary tooling into the monorepo by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12635
- Prevent browser translation from crashing license pricing by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12675
- Consolidate renderer cancellation workflows by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12858
- remotion.dev/brand: Add 100 GB video composition by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12856
- remotion.dev/brand: Crossfade README states at 30 fps by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12850
- remotion.dev/brand: Increase README logo to 280px by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12848
- remotion.dev/brand: Enlarge README logo by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12847
- Docs: Add native Studio playback to Chrome upgrade checks by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12833
- FFmpeg: Upgrade shlex to 1.3.0 by @app/dependabot in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12770
- Check CLI boolean flag types and defaults by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12822
- Skills: Warn when global Claude skills shadow project Remotion skills by @CreedTech in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12025
- Consolidate FFmpeg sources and build tooling by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12698
- Stabilize Lambda webhook timeout test by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12705
- Fix double AudioContext close in keep-alive test by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12704
- Restore cached example media at browser fixture URLs by @alec-watts in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12685
- Skip unnecessary builds in CI and deployments by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12693
- Align React and remove Copilot from installs by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12691
- `@remotion/promo-pages`: Fix frozen homepage videos after browser Back by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12692
- Reduce clone size by offloading media to R2 by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12676
- Skills: Add `/remotion-license` skill by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12653
- Sign up SDK visitors to the dedicated waitlist by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12642
- Import Chromium build recipes into the monorepo by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12637
- Astro example: Upgrade Astro to 7.3.3 by @app/dependabot in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12624
- `remotion`: Remove unused `happy-dom` devDependency by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12622
- `@remotion/mcp`: Remove discontinued package by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12618
- Upgrade Zod to 4.6.7 to fix GHSA-mrhx-c7xc-m3w5 by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12612

## New Contributors

- @kjgggggg made their first contribution in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12664

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/compare/v4.0.539...v4.0.540
